facts.fact: Microsoft launched its first Africa cloud data centres in 2019, organised as two live Azure regions in South Africa: South Africa North (Johannesburg) and South Africa West (Cape Town), which serve customers across Southern Africa.
facts.system: Microsoft Azure South Africa North and South Africa West

facts.fact: Microsoft operates cloud data centres in Johannesburg and Cape Town, launched in 2019 and serving outside customers such as South African banks running workloads on Azure.
facts.system: Microsoft South Africa North (Johannesburg) and South Africa West (Cape Town)

systems.system: Microsoft Azure South Africa West (Cape Town)
